rv.q: The result is a portrait that is playful in its theatrical imagination and haunting in its understanding of love, loss, and memory.
I do not think I will ever see better acting than that.
Both playwright and performer, Vanessa Severo (Frida Kahlo) is simply astonishing in this production.
Severo's interaction with this mercurial world, created by the technical artists under the direction of Joanie Schultz, elevates the production to something magical and memorable.
If you are a connoisseur of great acting, then by all means see this play. But see it for that, not expecting any great revelations, or insights, into Frida Kahlo.
